# Unconscious (psychoanalytic)

In [Freud](../philosophers/freud.md), the part of mental life withheld from consciousness, which shows itself in dreams, slips of the tongue and symptoms. [Lacan](../philosophers/lacan.md) rereads it through linguistics: it is "structured like a language".

**At stake in** : [Freedom of the will](../axes/freedom.md) · [Interiority](../axes/interiority.md)
